about.title: A small brand with a big soul
story: Businka is a small brand of handmade jewelry. We are based in Rostov-on-Don, and we craft every item by hand from Czech or Japanese seed beads.
Every necklace, earring or bracelet is dozens and hundreds of tiny beads, a careful color combination and meticulous work. That is why no two of our pieces are exactly alike.
We make jewelry that helps highlight your individuality and lift your mood. Wear it with joy — and if you need a custom piece, drop us a message on Telegram or give us a call.
